# ThawDay: full page text

> Complete text of thawday.com's pages: the homepage, the turkey timeline calculator, the ask page, and the twenty-nine question pages.
> ThawDay is a free turkey timeline tool for Thanksgiving. Type in your dinner time and turkey
> weight. You get dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast times. No ads, no accounts.
> Thaw times come from the USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.

## Homepage (https://thawday.com/)

For Thanksgiving 2026. Type in your dinner time. Get buy, thaw, brine, and roast dates. Brining is just soaking the bird in salt water first. It is optional. Free forever. No ads. No accounts. Ready in 30 seconds.

Buy. Thaw. Brine. Roast.

Countdown: days, hours, minutes, and seconds until Thanksgiving, Thursday, November 26, 2026. Next do-by: buy a frozen turkey by Sunday, November 15, 2026. Biggest birds (21 to 24 lb) move to the fridge Friday, November 20, 2026.

### Short answer for Thanksgiving 2026

Dinner is Thursday, November 26, 2026. Move a frozen bird to the fridge on:

- Up to 12 lb: Monday, November 23
- 13 to 16 lb: Sunday, November 22
- 17 to 20 lb: Saturday, November 21
- 21 to 24 lb: Friday, November 20

A 14 lb bird moves Sunday, November 22. Your dinner hour does not change this date.

### Thaw times at a glance

Use the fridge at 40 F or below: 24 hours per 4 to 5 pounds.

- 4 to 12 lb: fridge 1 to 3 days; cold water 2 to 6 hours
- 12 to 16 lb: fridge 3 to 4 days; cold water 6 to 8 hours
- 16 to 20 lb: fridge 4 to 5 days; cold water 8 to 10 hours
- 20 to 24 lb: fridge 5 to 6 days; cold water 10 to 12 hours

Short on time? Cold water: seal the bird in a leak-proof bag, submerge it in cold tap water, 30 minutes per pound, change the water every 30 minutes, cook right after. Never thaw on the counter.

USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.

### Three safe ways to thaw

Fridge: 24 hours per 4 to 5 lb, hands-off. Cold water: 30 minutes per lb, fastest. Microwave: per your oven manual, no waiting.

### How it works

You enter: dinner day and time, bird size in pounds. We do the math: USDA thaw charts, counted back from dinner. You get your dates: buy, thaw, brine, and roast.

### Two ways to use ThawDay

On this site: tap through the quiz, get the full dated plan and picture card. Print it. Share it.

In ChatGPT or Claude (coming soon): ask in plain words, follow up in the same chat. Both ways use USDA charts.

### Questions

When do I start thawing?
Allow 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. 12 to 16 pounds needs 3 to 4 days. Start 4 days before you cook. It keeps 1 to 2 days once thawed. Keep it in the fridge.

Is fridge thawing or cold water thawing better?
The fridge is hands-off. Cold water is faster. Seal it in a leak-proof bag, under cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Then cook right after. Never thaw on the counter.

Can I cook a turkey from frozen?
Yes. USDA says it is safe. It takes at least half longer than a thawed bird. For a 15 lb bird at 325 F: 5 hours 45 minutes at least, up to 6 hours 30 minutes. Do not use an oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs, 20 to 30 minutes in. The calculator gives the time for your bird.

How does the timeline tool work?
Tell it dinner time and turkey size. Get every date: buy, thaw, brine, roast.

Every question, answered in full: How long to thaw a turkey. When to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving. Can you thaw a turkey in cold water? Can you cook a turkey from frozen? How long can a thawed turkey stay in the fridge?

## Calculator (https://thawday.com/calculator)

When do I take the turkey out of the freezer? Type in your dinner time and turkey weight. You get buy, thaw, brine, and roast dates.

Three steps. Thirty seconds. Free.

This tool plans turkeys with no stuffing. For safety, the USDA does not recommend cooking stuffing inside the bird. Cook it in a casserole dish instead. Every time here is for an unstuffed turkey.

Not sure what size to buy? How many people eat? Want leftovers too? USDA says one pound per person. For leftovers, plan half a pound more each. The guest count sets the turkey weight: one pound per person, or one and a half pounds per person for leftovers, inside the tool's 8 to 24 pound range.

Inputs, in three tap steps: how many people eat (1 to 30) and want leftovers, which set the turkey weight, or the turkey weight itself (lb or kg, 8 to 24 lb); frozen or fresh; soak in salt water (brine), yes or no; dinner date; dinner time. Frozen, no brine, and Thanksgiving Day at 5:00 PM are pre-picked, so most people only answer the first step.

Output: your timeline (dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast times), plus a turkey card, one picture with the whole plan on it, good for the group chat (share or download as PNG). You can also print the plan.

Safety: When in doubt, use a meat thermometer: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

Prefer to ask in chat?
ThawDay is also built for ChatGPT and Claude. It is not in their stores yet.
In chat, there is no form. You just ask. Ask for the full plan, just the thaw time, or just the roast time. Change the weight and ask again. The new plan comes back in the same chat.
Here on the site, you get what chat does not give you: a picture card of your plan, a print view, a calendar file, and a share link. Both ways use USDA charts.

### FAQ

How much turkey per person?
Plan one pound of whole turkey per person. For leftovers, add half a pound per person. Bone and skin make up much of the weight.

Where do these numbers come from?
The USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service thaw chart and 325 F roasting chart. See footer date.

My turkey is still frozen and dinner is tomorrow. Am I doomed?
Use the cold-water method: about 30 minutes per pound, change the water every 30 minutes, cook it right after it thaws.

Can I cook a turkey from frozen?
Yes. USDA says it is safe, and it takes at least 50 percent longer than a thawed bird. At 325 F, a 15 lb bird needs 5 hours 45 minutes to 6 hours 30 minutes from frozen. Do not use an oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs after 20 to 30 minutes of baking. The cook-from-frozen section on this page gives the time for your bird.

Cook it from frozen (calculator section, frozen birds only)
No time to thaw at all? USDA says cooking a turkey from frozen is safe. It takes at least 50 percent longer than a thawed bird. The calculator gives the USDA from-frozen band for your bird's weight, the middle of that band, and the oven time for your dinner. From-frozen times from the USDA chart, checked Oct 30, 2026.

Stuffed or unstuffed?
This tool plans turkeys with no stuffing.

How do I know it is done?
A meat thermometer: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing. Color is not a reliable signal.

Does this work for Christmas dinner?
The math is the same. A Christmas version is planned.

What we don't do
Your plan stays on your device. The page saves it in your browser so it shows again when you return. We don't send your dinner details anywhere. The timeline math runs in your browser. We don't sell turkeys, groceries, or anything else. We don't ask for your email or an account. There is nothing to sign up for.

Our guarantees
In the calculator, we never receive what you type, not your date, your dinner hour, or your turkey's weight. No account, no email, and no cost. The full plan is yours on the spot. There are no ads on this site.

## How long to thaw a turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-turkey)

In the fridge: about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A 14 lb turkey needs 4 days. A 20 lb turkey needs 5 days. In cold water: 30 minutes per pound.

Thaw times by weight (USDA): 4 to 12 lb: fridge 1 to 3 days, cold water 2 to 6 hours. 12 to 16 lb: fridge 3 to 4 days, cold water 6 to 8 hours. 16 to 20 lb: fridge 4 to 5 days, cold water 8 to 10 hours. 20 to 24 lb: fridge 5 to 6 days, cold water 10 to 12 hours.

The fridge is hands-off. Cold water is faster: keep the bird in its wrapper, change the water every 30 minutes, cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. Once thawed, a turkey keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge before cooking.

## How long to thaw a 12 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-12-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 12 lb turkey needs 3 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Monday, November 23. In cold water, it needs 6 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a 16 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-16-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 16 lb turkey needs 4 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Sunday, November 22. In cold water, it needs 8 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a 20 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-20-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 20 lb turkey needs 5 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Saturday, November 21. In cold water, it needs 10 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a 24 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-24-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 24 lb turkey needs 6 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Friday, November 20. In cold water, it needs 12 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## When to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving (https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-thanksgiving)

Thanksgiving dinner is Thursday, November 26, 2026. Move a frozen turkey to the fridge on these dates: up to 12 lb on Monday, November 23 (3 days); 13 to 16 lb on Sunday, November 22 (4 days); 17 to 20 lb on Saturday, November 21 (5 days); 21 to 24 lb on Friday, November 20 (6 days). These are the same dates the ThawDay calculator gives for a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner. Already past your date? Use cold water today, or cook from frozen.

## Can you thaw a turkey in cold water? (https://thawday.com/thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water)

Yes. It is one of the two USDA-safe methods. Allow 30 minutes per pound: 8 lb about 4 hours, 12 lb about 6 hours, 14 lb about 7 hours, 16 lb about 8 hours, 20 lb about 10 hours, 24 lb about 12 hours. Keep the turkey in its leak-proof wrapper, cover it with cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Cold water only. Never thaw on the counter.

## Can you cook a turkey from frozen? (https://thawday.com/can-you-cook-a-frozen-turkey)

Yes. USDA says it is safe. Roast at 325 F; it takes at least 50 percent longer than a thawed bird. Times from frozen: up to 12 lb, 4 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes; 13 to 14 lb, 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours 45 minutes; 15 to 18 lb, 5 hours 45 minutes to 6 hours 30 minutes; 19 to 20 lb, 6 hours 30 minutes to 6 hours 45 minutes; 21 to 24 lb, 6 hours 45 minutes to 7 hours 30 minutes. Do not use an oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs 20 to 30 minutes in. Done at 165 F in the thickest part.

## How long can a thawed turkey stay in the fridge? (https://thawday.com/how-long-can-a-thawed-turkey-stay-in-the-fridge)

Cook it within 1 to 2 days. That is the USDA rule. The clock starts when the turkey is fully thawed. A fresh turkey is on the same clock: buy it 1 to 2 days before cooking. Cooked leftovers keep 3 to 4 days in the fridge; get them in within 2 hours of the meal.

## How long to cook a turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-cook-a-turkey)

At 325 F, unstuffed: up to 12 lb takes 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours. 13 to 14 lb takes 3 hours to 3 hours 45 minutes. 15 to 18 lb takes 3 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours 15 minutes. 19 to 20 lb takes 4 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes. 21 to 24 lb takes 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours. The chart aims, the thermometer decides: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing. For a 5 PM dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026: 12 lb in the oven by 1:47 PM, 16 lb by 12:40 PM, 20 lb by 12:17 PM, 24 lb by 11:55 AM. Rest 20 minutes before carving.

## Can you thaw a turkey on the counter? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-on-the-counter)

No. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer. A turkey that sat out for more than 2 hours cannot be made safe, by cooking or by freezing. Throw it out. Safe ways: the fridge, about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds at 40 F or below, or cold water at 30 minutes per pound.

## Can you thaw a turkey in the microwave? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-the-microwave)

Yes. USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your oven manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. ThawDay prints no microwave minutes, because the manual is the only honest source for them. Too big for the microwave: cold water at 30 minutes per pound, or the fridge at about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds.

## How much turkey per person? (https://thawday.com/how-much-turkey-per-person)

Plan one pound of whole turkey per person. For leftovers, add half a pound per person. Bone and skin make up much of the weight. Bird sizes: 8 people buy 8 lb, or 12 lb with leftovers; 12 people buy 12 lb, or 18 lb; 16 people buy 16 lb, or 24 lb; 20 people buy 20 lb, or two birds of 15 lb each when leftovers push the need to 30 lb.

## When to buy a turkey for Thanksgiving (https://thawday.com/when-to-buy-a-turkey-for-thanksgiving)

Frozen: buy by Sunday, November 15, 2026, eleven days before dinner (kitchen practice: frozen birds sell out the weekend before Thanksgiving). Fresh: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking, so Tuesday, November 24 or Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Frozen thaw starts by weight: 12 lb on Monday, November 23; 16 lb on Sunday, November 22; 20 lb on Saturday, November 21; 24 lb on Friday, November 20.

## How long do turkey leftovers last? (https://thawday.com/how-long-do-turkey-leftovers-last)

Use refrigerated turkey, stuffing, and gravy within 3 to 4 days. For Thanksgiving 2026 that window ends Sunday, November 29 to Monday, November 30. Discard any turkey, stuffing, and gravy left out at room temperature longer than 2 hours; 1 hour in temperatures above 90 F. Divide leftovers into smaller portions. Refrigerate or freeze in covered shallow containers for quicker cooling. If freezing leftovers, use within 2 to 6 months for best quality.

## Should you stuff a turkey? (https://thawday.com/should-you-stuff-a-turkey)

For optimum safety, stuffing a turkey is not recommended. For more even cooking, it is recommended you cook your stuffing outside the bird in a casserole. The stuffing must reach a safe minimum internal temperature of 165 F. ThawDay plans turkeys with no stuffing; its roast times are the unstuffed 325 F bands.

## How long should a turkey rest before carving? (https://thawday.com/how-long-should-a-turkey-rest-before-carving)

For quality, let the turkey stand for 20 minutes before carving to allow juices to set. The turkey will carve more easily. For a 5:00 PM dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, the rest starts at 4:40 PM for every weight; oven-in times run from 1:47 PM for a 12 lb bird to 11:55 AM for a 24 lb bird.

## Should you wash a turkey before cooking? (https://thawday.com/should-you-wash-a-turkey-before-cooking)

No. Washing or rinsing any meat or poultry is not recommended, and actually increases the risk you will cross-contaminate germs to other foods you're preparing. Water can splash bacteria up to 3 feet surrounding your sink. The one exception is a brined bird: Thanksgiving cooks who are purchasing a brined turkey, or brining their turkeys at home, must rinse the brine off before the turkey goes into the oven.

## Can you trust the pop-up timer on a turkey? (https://thawday.com/can-you-trust-the-pop-up-timer-on-a-turkey)

Not on its own. If your turkey has a pop-up temperature indicator, it is recommended that you also check the internal temperature of the turkey in the innermost part of the thigh and wing and the thickest part of the breast with a food thermometer. The minimum internal temperature should reach 165 F for safety.

## How long can you keep a turkey in the freezer? (https://thawday.com/how-long-can-you-keep-a-turkey-in-the-freezer)

Keep frozen until you are ready to thaw it. Turkeys can be kept frozen in the freezer indefinitely; however, cook within 1 year for best quality. The 1 year line is about flavor and texture, not safety. Turkey parts keep up to 9 months and giblets 3 to 4 months for best quality.

## What if you cook a turkey with the giblets inside? (https://thawday.com/what-if-you-cook-a-turkey-with-the-giblets-inside)

It depends on the bag. If the giblets were wrapped in paper, there is no concern, as long as the turkey is fully cooked to 165 F, measured with a food thermometer. If giblets were packed in a plastic bag, and the bag has been altered or melted by the cooking process, do not use the giblets or the poultry because harmful chemicals may have leached into the surrounding meat.

## How to reheat leftover turkey? (https://thawday.com/how-to-reheat-leftover-turkey)

When reheating leftovers, be sure they reach 165 F as measured with a food thermometer. Cover leftovers to reheat; that retains moisture and ensures the food heats all the way through. Reheat sauces, soups and gravies by bringing them to a rolling boil. Frozen leftovers can reheat without thawing, in the oven or microwave. For Thanksgiving 2026, use refrigerated turkey, stuffing, and gravy within 3 to 4 days, by Sunday, November 29 to Monday, November 30.

## What temperature to cook a turkey? (https://thawday.com/what-temperature-to-cook-a-turkey)

Set the oven temperature no lower than 325 F and be sure the turkey is completely thawed. The USDA roasting chart is set at 325 F: up to 12 lb takes 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours, and 21 to 24 lb takes 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours. A meat thermometer decides when the bird is done: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing.

## When should I take the turkey out of the freezer for Christmas? (https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-christmas)

Christmas dinner is Friday, December 25, 2026. Move a frozen turkey to the fridge by weight: up to 12 lb on Tuesday, December 22 (3 days); 13 to 16 lb on Monday, December 21 (4 days); 17 to 20 lb on Sunday, December 20 (5 days); 21 to 24 lb on Saturday, December 19 (6 days). Fridge thawing takes about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A fresh bird: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking, on Wednesday, December 23 or Thursday, December 24.

## Can you thaw a turkey in cold water overnight? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water-overnight)

No. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. An overnight soak breaks both rules, because the water warms toward room temperature with no one changing it. Cold water takes 30 minutes per pound in daylight hours. The fridge is the overnight method: for Thanksgiving 2026, move a 12 lb bird on Monday, November 23 and a 24 lb bird on Friday, November 20.
